references.text: Describes how the righteous will flourish like a tree, which can be compared to how the mustard seed grows to become larger than all garden plants.
Speaks of how those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength and soar on wings like eagles, parallel to how the mustard seed grows beyond its apparent limitation.
Jesus uses a similar image of the mustard seed to illustrate the nature of the kingdom of heaven.
Luke's version of the parable of the mustard seed, emphasizing how something small can grow into something large and inviting.
Matthew's version of the parable of the mustard seed, which also highlights how the smallest of all seeds can grow to become the largest of plants.
